title: Paper 2-D shapes
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 2: Statistics; position and direction; shape; assessment
intro: Lesson 79: Sort shapes and make patterns. To understand how to sort 2-D and 3-D shapes by their properties

questions.q: Sort: circle, sphere, square, cube into 2-D and 3-D.
questions.model: Teacher asks: can I hold it? Sphere and cube are solid.

questions.q: Rule: 'can roll'. Which roll: tin, box, ball?
Shape with 3 sides goes in which group: 3 sides or 4 sides?
Sort the 8 shapes on the sheet by number of sides.
Sort household objects by 'has a curved face'.
Sort the same shapes a second way and say the rule.
Big question: how many ways can we sort?
questions.a: Many: by sides, faces, curved or flat, 2-D or 3-D.
